{"id":1768763295,"question_id":4008,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"10 months, 1 week","timestamp":1757723723,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"4 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1768763295/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Restore Finishing Order","memory":"52.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> recoverOrder(vector<int>& order, vector<int>& friends) {\n        unordered_map<int,int>mp;\n        vector<int>ans;\n        \n        for(auto f : friends)\n        {\n            mp[f]++;\n        }\n\n        for(auto elem : order)\n        {\n            if(mp[elem] == 1)\n            {\n                ans.push_back(elem);\n            }\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"restore-finishing-order","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":791}
